trajectory_summary: The call is customer-led throughout: Robert dictates pace, asks the real qualifying/financial questions, and sets his own conditions while Holland reacts, half-answers, and stitches together a Wednesday time. Energy leaked in the middle third on scope-creep answers and a utility mix-up, and the bill was never captured live, only promised by text.

primary_coaching_focus.topic: Scope creep and missing escape hatch on financing/warranty questions
primary_coaching_focus.quote: I'm not exactly sure what options they are, just because I'm I'm just like a scheduler.
